scope: Isolated30-day logical-duty unit/person experiment with canonical safety; objective_scope specifies modeled tiers. Not production architecture activation/selection.
objective_scope: Current production enhanced balanced tiers: required coverage, coverage, worst call-level gap, total call-level gaps, squared count deviation, hours, extra, weekend, night, holiday, workload, spacing/history, preferences. Selected equal-count or covered-duty availability policy, canonical monthly membership and normalized logical demand; fixed opportunity universe for every layout. Two synthetic holiday dates; no preference costs or repair replacement requests. Per-tier proof receipts remain authoritative.
budget_scope: Same per-method monotonic wall allowance including model construction, all solver calls and canonical validation; common fixture/candidate preprocessing reported separately. Blocking stages may overrun; report actual overrun, not a hard-cancel guarantee.
template_scope: Initial alternating unit layout is prescribed for this experiment, not generated by the current production template.

memory.scope: Sampled whole Python process RSS including native CP-SAT, shared fixture and prior retained allocations; not continuous peaks or isolated method memory.
